name: SumAddon
author: shariful700453

sections.description:
Sumaddon is a lightweight addon toolkit for WordPress & Elementor. It provides a collection of animated button widgets with hover effects, customizable styles, and multiple animation directions.

Included Widgets:

  • Sumaddon Button — Animated slide-up hover effect
  • Arrow Button — Animated slide with icon support
  • Right Arrow Button — Text + icon slide horizontally to the right
  • Left Arrow Button — Text + icon slide horizontally to the left
  • Down Arrow Button — Text + icon slide downward
  • Top Right Arrow Button — Diagonal slide toward top-right
  • Top Left Arrow Button — Diagonal slide toward top-left
  • Down Right Arrow Button — Diagonal slide toward bottom-right
  • Down Left Arrow Button — Diagonal slide toward bottom-left

Features:

  • Full typography control for each widget
  • Padding, border radius, and border controls
  • Normal and hover state color controls
  • Responsive padding support
  • Dynamic content support
  • Works with any Elementor theme
sections.installation:
1. Upload the sumaddon folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install via the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure Elementor is installed and activated.
  4. Edit any page or post with Elementor.
  5. Search for “Sumaddon” in the Elementor widget panel.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes. Sumaddon is an Elementor addon and requires Elementor (free version) to be installed and activated.

Which version of Elementor is required?

Sumaddon requires Elementor 3.0 or higher.

Is this plugin compatible with Elementor Pro?

Yes, Sumaddon works alongside both Elementor free and Elementor Pro.

Can I use multiple button widgets on the same page?

Yes, you can use as many Sumaddon widgets as you need on any page.
